grain: realized lot (closing event x opening event)

columns.name: firm
columns.meaning: the registry-derived firm scope this row belongs to; never a typed token

columns.name: account_id
columns.meaning: the custodian account id in the declaration's account form (10-char zero-padded)

columns.name: business_date
columns.meaning: the lot's closing date, the custodian's own

columns.name: lot_id
columns.meaning: the closing event id and the opening event id joined by '/': NOT unique alone (distinct lots can share it); unique with quantity, proceeds and realized gain within a closing date and account, and a repeat of that whole key refuses

columns.name: ticker_symbol
columns.meaning: the custodian's ticker, blank where it carries none

columns.name: cusip
columns.meaning: the security's CUSIP, blank where it carries none

columns.name: quantity
columns.meaning: the quantity of this lot that closed

columns.name: acquired_date
columns.meaning: the lot's acquired date as the custodian states it; null on ACQUIRED_DATE_ABSENT. A date before 2010 is kept, never estimated or altered

columns.name: holding_term
columns.meaning: the custodian's holding-term flag read through the producer's declared map

columns.name: holding_trading_days
columns.meaning: trading days in [acquired_date, business_date] by lib/trading_calendar.py; null on PRE_2010_OPENED (the calendar raises before 2010) and on ACQUIRED_DATE_ABSENT

columns.name: proceeds
columns.meaning: the lot's closing proceeds, net of the trade's fees, as the custodian states them

columns.name: cost_basis
columns.meaning: the lot's cost basis as basis_source says: the custodian's cost_basis_unamortized (the column satisfying proceeds - cost_basis == realized_gain, chosen by measurement) where basis_source is CUSTODIAN, otherwise the re-measured basis (see basis_source)

columns.name: realized_gain
columns.meaning: proceeds less cost_basis: the custodian's own gain_loss_dollars where basis_source is CUSTODIAN, otherwise re-measured from the same basis the lot carried while open

columns.name: custodian_cost_basis
columns.meaning: the custodian's own cost_basis_unamortized for the lot, carried beside cost_basis and never used in the activity identity when basis_source is not CUSTODIAN

columns.name: basis_source
columns.meaning: where cost_basis comes from: CUSTODIAN (the custodian's own basis), IN_KIND_TRANSFER_VALUE (the lot arrived in kind: measured from its market value on the transfer date) or WASH_SALE_EXCLUDED_BASIS (the custodian's basis carries a disallowed loss no cash paid for: measured from the cash paid, basis less the disallowed loss)

columns.name: closing_tie
columns.meaning: the lot's relation to its closing transaction in the custodian's transactions; the reason where it does not tie

columns.name: method_version
columns.meaning: the method this figure was produced under (3)

columns.name: coverage
columns.meaning: why a calendar-derived column is null; MEASURED where none is

i_mece_over_a_declared_domain.coverage: domain: 'why is a calendar-derived column of this lot null'. MEASURED (none is) | PRE_2010_OPENED (the lot was opened before lib/trading_calendar.py's floor of 2010-01-01, which raises there: holding_trading_days is null and the custodian's dates are kept) | ACQUIRED_DATE_ABSENT (the custodian row has no acquired date). COVERED BY SUBTRACTION: a lot either carries an acquired date or not; one that does is either on or after the floor or before it.
i_mece_over_a_declared_domain.closing_tie: domain: 'does this realized lot tie to its closing transaction in the custodian's transactions'. TIED | NO_ORDER_NUMBER (the lot carries no order number to look one up by) | NO_TRADE_FOR_ORDER (no trade row for this account, order and security in the searched partitions) | TRADE_DATE_DIFFERS (the trade is not on the lot's closing date) | QUANTITY_DIFFERS (the order's lots do not sum to the trade's quantity) | PROCEEDS_DIFFER (they do not sum to its net amount). COVERED BY SUBTRACTION in the producer's order: an order number exists or not; a trade exists or not; it is on the date or not; the quantities agree or not; the proceeds agree or not. A lot is tied or untied WITH the other lots of its order, because one trade closes against several lots and only their sum is the trade.
i_mece_over_a_declared_domain.holding_term: domain: the custodian's holding-term flag. LONG_TERM | SHORT_TERM. A flag outside the declared map REFUSES: it is a defect, not a third member.

rule24_record.ii_same_grain: Every member of coverage and closing_tie is a LOT property; holding_term is a lot property; none is an account property.
rule24_record.iii_intent_coherence: closing_tie answers ONE question -- the lot's relation to its closing transaction. coverage answers a different one -- why a calendar-derived column is null -- and neither says whether the gain is right.
rule24_record.iv_state_coherence: WHICH VALUES ONE REMEDY DOES NOT MOVE. A transaction partition landing late moves NO_TRADE_FOR_ORDER only. The calendar gaining pre-2010 coverage moves PRE_2010_OPENED only. Neither moves the other axis.

basis_source.i_mece_over_a_declared_domain: domain: 'where does this lot's cost_basis come from'. CUSTODIAN (the custodian's basis stands) | IN_KIND_TRANSFER_VALUE (the lot arrived in kind) | WASH_SALE_EXCLUDED_BASIS (the custodian's basis carries a disallowed loss). COVERED BY SUBTRACTION: a lot either arrived in kind or not; one that did not either carries a disallowed loss or not; the producer sets the in-kind source first and it takes precedence over the wash-sale one, so each lot is in exactly one member and the rest are CUSTODIAN.
basis_source.ii_same_grain: Every member is a LOT property; none speaks of an account or a day.
basis_source.iii_intent_coherence: basis_source answers ONE question, where the basis figure was measured from, and nothing else; coverage (why a calendar-derived column is null) and closing_tie (how a realized lot ties to its transaction) are separate columns.
basis_source.iv_state_coherence: WHICH VALUES ONE REMEDY DOES NOT MOVE. basis_source is moved by exactly two producer rules (an in-kind reference, a wash-sale carry-over) and by no other; neither rule moves coverage, closing_tie or custodian_cost_basis, which keeps the custodian's own figure beside the measured one.
basis_source.token_census: comp-find word-boundary regex (WASH_SALE_EXCLUDED_BASIS|IN_KIND_TRANSFER_VALUE) over the worktree corpus (corpus=all): 26 hit(s) across 61,428 file(s) scanned, 24 ephemeral-floor, 1 unreadable and 3,695 binary files not searched; first-party definition in the producer only (DEF=2 bands), the rest are this project's records, task orders and the checker. CUSTODIAN is the custody vocabulary's own word and is adopted by the producer's constant BASIS_CUSTODIAN; no other schema in org/standards carries a basis_source column.

No Schwab code survives into this table (no tr_cd, sb_cd, h_t, l_s, close_event_id column); the custodian's lot-table and column names are declared in sources.json (the custody entry's lot_source), which the producer reads through lot_spec(); row IRPT_DASHBD-W20-S1 closed.
producer_pin: data/assets/scripts/gold/irpt_reporting/account_activity_lots.py -- the ARROW_REALIZED schema this hash is taken from (method_version 3, schema_version 1.2). The producer and this contract land together.
limits_of_method_version_1: method_version 1: one row per custodian realized-lot row; the tie is a lookup by account, order number and security against the TRADE rows of the searched transaction partitions; a lot closed by an event with no order number (an expiry, an assignment) ties NOTHING and says so. REVISED for method_version 3 (TO-DB-b-41): see the column meanings; in-kind legs are flows and departures at market value on the transfer date, fee-admin and withheld-tax cash rows are negative components of income, and a lot's basis is re-measured per basis_source.
primary_key_meaning: one row per realized lot: lot_id (closing event id / opening event id) with the quantity that closed, the proceeds it closed for and the realized gain is unique within a closing date and account. REVISED under IRPT_DASHBD.TO-DB-b-47 (round 28): lot_id alone repeats (distinct lots share an id: 87 ids over 175 rows in 36 accounts on 2026-10-06, none identical in every column; LOT_KEY_E1.json) and quantity separates them; REVISED again under IRPT_DASHBD.TO-DB-b-73 (round 37): on 2026-10-07 one pair still shared the whole key (the two halves of a wash-sale split lot: same order, opening event, acquired date and quantity) and proceeds separates it (LOTS_KEY_E1.json, 0.9.0_WK_IRPT_DASHBD~50); REVISED again under IRPT_DASHBD.TO-DB-b-87 (round 41): on 2026-10-08 eight pairs (eight accounts) still shared the whole key (the two halves of a wash-sale split lot closing the same quantity for the same proceeds and cost basis) and realized_gain separates all eight, the only column of this table that does (LOTS_KEY_R41.json and rule24_realized_gain_key.md, 0.9.0_WK_IRPT_DASHBD~62); a row identical in every column to another still refuses
